description:
Mini Long Beach Cruiser XXL 1000 Electric Folding Step Through Ebike
🚲 Compact. Powerful. Made for Everyday Adventure.
Don’t let the size fool you, The Mini Long Beach Cruiser Folding Electric Bike 1000W is packed with premium power, bold cruiser style, and the kind of ride-anywhere versatility that makes every trip smoother, faster, and more fun.
Whether you're commuting to work, coasting by the beach, or exploring your neighborhood, this foldable e-bike delivers 750W of motor power (and peaks at 1500W)in a stylish, space-saving design that fits your lifestyle.
✅ Solving the Real Struggles Riders Face:
❌ Problem: “Most folding bikes feel underpowered and uncomfortable.”
✅ Solution: This bike packs a 1000W rear hub motor with a peak output of 2000W, giving you the torque, speed, and confidence to tackle hills, wind, and city traffic, without breaking a sweat.
❌ Problem: “I live in a small space or need to store my bike easily.”
✅ Solution: The folding frame makes it perfect for apartment dwellers, RVers, or anyone tight on storage. Fold it and roll it: no garage required.
❌ Problem: “I want a comfortable ride, not a stiff city commuter.”
✅ Solution: Inspired by beach cruiser design, it features wide handlebars, an upright seating position, and a plush saddle for all-day riding comfort.
❌ Problem: “Charging too often slows me down.”
✅ Solution: The 48V lithium-ion battery delivers up to 40 miles per charge, so you can ride longer, explore more, and recharge less.
🌟 Why Riders Love the Mini Long Beach Cruiser 750W

1000W motor (2000W peak) for powerful acceleration and hill-climbing

Folding frame for compact storage and travel flexibility

Fat 20x4” tires for extra traction and comfort on pavement, grass, gravel, or sand

Front suspension fork for smooth riding over bumps and cracks

Throttle + 5 levels of pedal assist to customize your ride style

Classic beach cruiser aesthetics blended with modern electric muscle

💬 What Riders Are Saying:

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “I ride it to work every day and fold it right into my office. And the power? Wow, it’s way more than I expected.” – Justin P.
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “Super comfy, looks amazing, and handles everything from steep streets to sand. Perfect for my RV travels.” – Megan K.
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ “Small enough to fold. Strong enough to fly. Love this thing!” – Chris D.

🎁 Big Cat Bonuses:
✅ Reliable Support from the Big Cat Bikes Team
Power Meets Portability in a Cruiser You'll Love to Ride
The Mini Long Beach Cruiser Folding Electric Bike 1000W proves you don’t need a big frame to enjoy big performance. Ride in comfort. Fold it with ease. Explore without limits.
